basics.name: Raihan Yusuf
basics.label: Fullstack Developer
basics.summary: A results-driven Fullstack Developer specializing in building scalable and user-friendly web applications. Began their web development journey in March 2024 at Pijar Camp by Telkom Indonesia, followed by hands-on experience as an intern at Imperial Healthtech. Since October 2024, serving as a React JS Programmer at PT Nutech Integrasi, leveraging Next.js, TypeScript, and Golang to build efficient frontend and backend systems, optimize application performance, and deliver impactful digital solutions.
basics.title: React JS Programmer @ PT Nutech Integrasi | Fullstack Developer | Next.js | Typescript | Golang

work.summary: Principal frontend engineer across six production-grade enterprise systems in transportation, logistics, and operational technology, with voluntary backend contributions on a Go microservices railway platform.
highlights: Engineered production-grade frontend applications as the principal React/Next.js developer across six enterprise systems, owning 94% of commits on a national rail ticketing platform serving thousands of daily passengers.
Optimized frontend performance through code splitting, lazy loading, SQL query tuning, and React memoization, cutting dashboard load times by up to 60% and reducing bundle size by 15-25%.
Strengthened code quality by leading test coverage from under 20% to 80%+ through 2,000+ unit tests, reducing critical production bugs by up to 95%.
Reduced technical debt through consistent refactoring cadence with over 150 refactoring and dead-code-removal commits while maintaining feature parity.

Architected reusable frontend infrastructure including centralized encrypted API clients, session-correlated observability logging, and theming systems via Ant Design ConfigProvider, standardizing every backend interaction across modules.
Delivered a full internationalization (i18n) infrastructure supporting Indonesian and English markets, reducing localization time by 70% and accelerating multi-region readiness.

work.summary: First real-world software engineering experience building frontend applications for a medical records system, collaborating through Slack and Jira while learning healthcare workflows and FHIR SatuSehat API integration.
highlights: Engineered frontend applications for a medical records system implementing FHIR SatuSehat API integration to enable healthcare data exchange.
Developed collaborative engineering workflows using Slack and Jira, improving task management and development productivity.
Contributed to understanding complex medical workflow processes and healthcare application requirements within the healthtech domain.
Built foundational frontend architecture for healthcare applications, demonstrating rapid learning in a specialized industry.
Studied and developed hard skills, such as Golang, React.js, Next.js, and Javascript.
Created and completed projects like Peworld, Blanja, and Mama Recipe.
Learned soft skills, such as self, growth mindset, public speaking, personal branding, self-management, time management, reflection, life plan, and work ethic to become a professional individual.
Thesis: “Implementation of Super Encryption on Video Cryptography: Combination of Vigenere Cipher and Transposition Myszkowski”
Additional Research: “Implementation of Tempellemahbang Tourism Village Website, Jepon, Blora for Promotion and Increasing Visitors”
Studied programming languages, including Python, Java, HTML, PHP, and SQL.

projects.name: Airport Train Web Reservation
projects.description: A reservation web application for PT. Kereta Commuter Indonesia and in collaboration with the KCI RTS back-end team, enabling schedule search, seat reservation, and e-ticket purchase for the airport train service, owned as the dominant contributor across an active project cycles from February–May 2025 and April–July 2026.
highlights: Engineered an interactive seat-selection engine with column-grouped dynamic rendering, round-trip seat state management, and a free-seating mode.
Architected a centralized encrypted API client with interceptors, bearer-token injection, refresh-token handling, and session-correlated structured logging.
Implemented AES-CBC/PKCS7 payload encryption for cookie-stored reservation state to protect sensitive booking data.
Delivered client-side PDF e-ticket generation with PDF417 barcodes, removing server dependency for ticket issuance.
Upgraded the application stack to Next.js 16, React 19, and Ant Design 6 with ConfigProvider theming.

Delivered complete dark mode implementation across 50+ components with zero layout regressions.
Implemented a push notification system reducing response time by 35%.
Built a user management system with magic link authentication and role-based access control.

Delivered robust billing management with retrieval, download validation, and error handling.
